title: An-Nur: What the Classical Scholars Said “Allah Is the Light” Actually Means
excerpt: The Quran names Allah as light exactly once, in the Light Verse. Ibn Abbas read it as Guide, Mujahid as the One directing their affairs, as-Suddi as radiance, and al-Jalalayn turned the noun into an agent.
seo_title: An-Nur: Is Allah the Light? The Divine Name Explained
seo_description: An-Nur appears once in the Quran, at 24:35. Ibn Abbas read it as Guide, al-Jalalayn as the One who illuminates. What the classical scholars actually said.
